## TargetBuildReport.outcomes property

One outcome per authored feature and subject on this target. When `status` is `failed` these are what the projection decided before the target failed (a skill whose fallback could not be built is `unavailable`<!-- -->); no form exists that delivers them.

**Signature:**

```typescript
outcomes: FeatureOutcome[];
```
